purpose: Deterministically extract the one owner-approved quarantined generic stone-tower candidate from its white matte, remove only its model-made floor-shadow rows, retain one connected textile landmark, and uniformly place it on a transparent scalable background canvas without painting, reconstruction, or inference.

allowed: fixed white-matte extraction and edge-color decontamination
deterministic filling of fully enclosed white-matte stitch pinholes
fixed removal of all alpha in source rows 712 and below, which contain only the reviewed model-made contact-shadow tail
blocked: volcano, vegetation, terrain, character, UI, or scene composition

matte.post_resample_component_selection: retain the largest 8-connected nonzero-alpha component after every resize to suppress isolated white-matte ringing pixels
matte.external_background: discard, including disconnected and border-connected pixels

contact_shadow.rationale: The threshold-32 selected component remains tower-wide through row 711; rows 712 through 721 taper only as the reviewed neutral floor-shadow tail.

matte.edge_color: uncomposite soft-edge RGB from the fixed white matte using the computed alpha; hard foreground retains exact source RGB

source_landmarks.method: reviewed center of the retained tower base immediately above the discarded shadow tail; decorative presentation anchor only, never terrain authority

resampling.alpha: premultiplied during filtering, straight RGBA in PNG
resampling.png: 8-bit non-interlaced RGBA, filter type 0, deterministic zlib level 9
